'''Neon''' was a [[Gas/Legends|gas]] used in the lighting of neon tubes, particularly in signs. It comprised a small percentage of the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of [[Brath Qella]].<ref name="BTS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>
